page.title: Our Team
page.seo_title: Our Team of M&A Experts - IMAA
page.search_description: Meet our experts coming from over 20 countries, faculty, staff, and our advisory in the field of M&A practice in Imaa-institute.
page.hero_intro: Meet our experts, faculty, staff and our advisory board to find out who stands behind the Institute.
page.faculty_intro_html: Compounding both academic excellence and internationally renowned business experience, the IMAA faculty have helped propel our institute to the forefront of M&A global education. Our growing faculty of more than 60 professors represent a diverse group of professionals, coming from over 20 countries; they work as corporate executives, entrepreneurs, researchers, consultants and professors. Their expertise makes them subject matter experts, groundbreaking researchers, and award-winning authors. This intersection of practical industry insight, theoretical knowledge, and passion for teaching that our faculty brings to each training strikes at the heart of what IMAA seeks to be.
page.staff_intro_html: Our international team of highly qualified professionals is here to support you. Please feel free to contact us anytime so we can better understand your needs and help you achieve your professional development goals.

cards.title: International M&A Expert
cards.text: This course dives deep into the entire M&A process- from strategy and valuation to execution and post merger integration (PMI).

cards.title: Certified Post Merger Integration Expert
cards.text: CPMI prepares you for integration issues post -merger, starting with integration planning, up to governance and project management to implement the integration.

cards.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Professional Expert
cards.text: The certification dives into the nuts and bolts of the transaction journey—auditing, consulting, deal advisory, and including insights into running a successful M&A practice.

cards.title: Legal Mergers & Acquisition Expert
cards.text: This certification covers the legal aspects of M&A, including best practices, legal contracts, tax considerations, and deal structuring in different geographies and jurisdictions .

cards.title: HR Mergers & Acquisition Expert
cards.text: HRM&A covers all aspects of the transaction process relevant to human resources, including strategy, due diligence, Post Merger Integration, and compensation benefits.

cards.title: Certified Separation, Carve-Out and Divestment Expert
cards.text: This training covers the entire divestment life cycle, from analyzing key business drivers and structuring the Transition Services Agreement to executing and implementing separations.

cards.title: Valuation Training with Prof. Aswath Damodaran
cards.text: This training will provide you with the fundamentals of each approach to valuation, with limitations and caveats on the use of each, as well as extended examples in application.

members.biography_html: Professor Aswath Damodaran is the Kerschner Family Chair Professor of Finance at the Stern School of Business at New York University. Over decades he has created and helped shape the field of valuation. He teaches the corporate finance and valuation courses in the MBA and executive programs. Being at NYU since 1986, he has received the Stern School of Business Excellence in Teaching Award. His research interests lie in valuation, portfolio management and applied corporate finance. He has published papers in the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, the Journal of Financial Economics and the Review of Financial Studies.
